leadText:
New Sword Player (Japanese: VSトルネロスれいじゅうフォルムII VS II), titled VS Tornadus Therian Forme II in the Shogakukan Asia translation, is the 533rd chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the ninth chapter of the .

It is subtitled Tornadus: Therian Forme II (Japanese: ニュー・ソードプレイヤー New Sword Player) in the VIZ Media translation and New Sword Player in the Shogakukan Asia translation.
